summary: Added reload functionality to extension picker. CR on a loaded extension now shows a vim.ui.select submenu (Unload/Reload/Cancel) instead of directly unloading. A new [Reload All] special entry reloads all loaded extensions in dependency-safe order with error summary notification. Both files verified with nvim --headless dofile.

artifacts.summary: Added vim.ui.select submenu for loaded extensions on CR; added is_reload_all handler with dependency-safe loop; updated four guard conditions
Added [Reload All] special entry in create_special_entries() just above [Keyboard Shortcuts]
Implementation summary with verification and decision notes
